title: Council Decision (CFSP) 2026/2622 of 25 November 2026 amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russia’s actions destabilising the situation in Ukraine

paras.text: Official Journal of the European Union
EN L series

sections.heading: amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russia’s actions destabilising the situation in Ukraine

paras.text: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,
paras.loc: amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russi, para 1

paras.text: Having regard to the Treaty on European Union and in particular Article 29 thereof,
paras.loc: amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russi, para 2

paras.text: Having regard to the proposal from the High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy,
paras.loc: amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russi, para 3

paras.text: Whereas:

amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russi, para 5

paras.text: On 31 July 2014, the Council adopted Decision 2014/512/CFSP ( 1 ) .
paras.loc: amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russi, para 6
amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russi, para 7

paras.text: In its conclusions of 15 and 16 October 2026, the European Council reaffirmed its continued firm and unwavering support for Ukraine’s independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity within its internationally recognised borders. The European Council stated that the Union will continue to provide, in coordination with like-minded partners and allies, comprehensive political, financial, economic, humanitarian, military and diplomatic support to Ukraine and its people. The European Council strongly condemned the escalation by Russia of its large-scale, deliberate and systematic missile and drone attacks against Ukraine’s civilians and civilian infrastructure. The European Council also expressed the Union’s determination to further increase pressure on Russia so that it stops its brutal war of aggression and engages in meaningful negotiations towards peace.
paras.loc: amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russi, para 8
amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russi, para 9

paras.text: In view of the gravity of the situation, it is appropriate to adopt further restrictive measures.
paras.loc: amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russi, para 10
amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russi, para 11

paras.text: In particular, 15 new entities should be added to the list of natural or legal persons, entities or bodies set out in Annex IV to Decision 2014/512/CFSP, namely the list of persons, entities and bodies which form part of Russia’s military and industrial complex or which have commercial or other links with or otherwise support Russia’s military and industrial complex or its defence and security sector in its war of aggression against Ukraine, on which tighter export restrictions regarding dual-use goods and technology, as well as goods and technology which might contribute to the technological enhancement of Russia’s defence and security sector, are imposed. In addition, it is appropriate to remove from that list one entity incorporated in a third country other than Russia.
paras.loc: amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russi, para 12
amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russi, para 13

paras.text: Further action by the Union is needed in order to implement certain measures.
paras.loc: amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russi, para 14
amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russi, para 15

paras.text: Decision 2014/512/CFSP should therefore be amended accordingly,
paras.loc: amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russi, para 16

paras.text: HAS ADOPTED THIS DECISION:
paras.loc: amending Decision 2014/512/CFSP concerning restrictive measures in view of Russi, para 17

paras.text: Annex IV to Decision 2014/512/CFSP is amended in accordance with the Annex to this Decision.
This Decision shall enter into force on the day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union .
Done at Brussels, 25 November 2026.
For the Council
The President
T. BYRNE

( 1 ) Council Decision 2014/512/CFSP of 31 July 2014 concerning restrictive measures in view of Russia’s actions destabilising the situation in Ukraine ( OJ L 229, 31.7.2014, p. 13 , ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/dec/2014/512/oj ).
